title: Implement request-variable substitution
objective: Replace every $${variableName}$$ placeholder across request assets using constructed parameters, JSON-serializing complex values and failing on unresolved variables. Contract sections: requests/README.md#placeholder-substitution; requests/README.md#processing-order. Explicit human operator confirmation is required before modifying requests/README.md.

branch.name: wi-0017-request-variable-substitution
branch.rationale: The record captures bounded planning without creating or switching a branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest({ requestName, parameters, files, ... }); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation.

scope.name: exact-syntax
scope.description: The engine matches exact syntax and resolves nested parameter paths.

scope.name: value-serialization
scope.description: Primitive and complex values render predictably through safe JSON serialization.
scope.reason: Files must receive valid inspectable content.

scope.name: complete-asset-pass
scope.description: Every configured asset receives replacement before parsing.
scope.reason: Variables can occur in every supported file.

scope.name: missing-values
scope.description: Missing variables fail before completion and no unresolved placeholder reaches the request.
scope.reason: Explicit failure is safer than silent configuration drift.

scope.name: authoritative-contract
scope.description: Implement only the authoritative contract sections [Placeholder substitution](#placeholder-substitution), [Processing order](#processing-order). Do not modify requests/README.md without explicit human operator confirmation.
scope.reason: The request README is the source of truth for this implementation batch.

nonGoals.name: implementation
